name: hold-button
title: Hold Button
description: A confirmation button that fills with colour while you keep it pressed, then switches to a done label when the hold completes. Letting go too soon drains the fill back out.
use: A destructive action needs deliberate confirmation so an accidental click cannot delete data.
avoid: Requires a sustained press, so it slows frequent actions and can confuse users on touch screens.
a11y: Space or Enter starts the hold and Escape cancels; progress is only described by a static hint, not announced as it fills. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A rounded charcoal button with a light label sits centred on a near-black rounded card, below a bold white heading and two lines of muted grey body copy. A faint caption sits on the stage below the card.
behaves: Pressing and holding fills the button left to right with red, led by a wavy crest; holding to the end swaps the label to a done message with a soft glow and pulse. Releasing early drains the red back out.
customise: Label, done label, icons, fill/background/text colours, size, radius, hold and release times, wave and glow are all props. The wavy crest shape only changes by editing the source CSS.
weight: light: One button, a raf loop only while pressed, CSS transitions the rest of the time.
demo: Delete "Q3 Launch Plan"? with a warning that 14 files and 3 shared links will be removed.
issues: Frame 4 catches the done label mid-blur, so the success wording is never readable in the clip.
polishWhy: Clean card layout and a convincing liquid fill; the done state is only caught blurred.
